_comment: Structural-gate limits per corpus case (tools/structural_gate.py). max_abs_delta_bp bounds every glyph-origin and rule-geometry delta relative to the case's first glyph; max_placement_delta_bp bounds the absolute page placement of that first glyph. pdfTeX writes three decimals, so 0.003 bp is its own rounding; the default leaves a little headroom above that and is NOT a claim of sub-0.01 fidelity beyond this corpus. regress_tolerance_bp is the allowed worsening against a recorded baseline.
